Questions.A: The Jews who had been comforting her in the house followed her. (31)

Questions.Q: Where did they think that Mary was going?
Questions.A: They thought she was going to the tomb to mourn. (31)

Questions.Q: What do you think a tomb is?
Questions.A: Key Term Check: A tomb is a cavity that someone cuts/digs out of a hillside. It was/is used as a place to bury a dead person. A tomb would often have a large rock that could be rolled in front of the opening by someone to seal the tomb.

Questions.Q: What did Mary do when she came to Jesus?
Questions.A: She knelt down at his feet. (32)

Questions.Q: What did Mary say to Jesus?
Questions.A: She said, "Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died." (32)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus see?
Questions.A: He saw that Mary and the other Jews with her were weeping. (33)

Questions.Q: What did he feel?
Questions.A: He was troubled and deeply moved/very sad. (33)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus ask them?
Questions.A: He asked them where they had laid/buried Lazarus. (34)

Questions.Q: What was their answer?
Questions.A: They told him to come and see. (34)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus do?
Questions.A: He wept. (35)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that some of the Jews commented about Jesus's love for Lazarus?
Questions.A: They commented because they saw him weeping. (36)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that some of the Jews thought that Jesus should have been able to keep Lazarus from dying?
Questions.A: They thought that because he had healed the blind man. (37)

Section.heading: John 11:38-44 Jesus raised Lazarus from the dead.

Questions.Q: What great thing did Jesus do in these verses?
Questions.A: He raised Lazarus from the dead. (43-44)

Questions.Q: Where did Jesus go?
Questions.A: He went to the tomb. (38)

Questions.Q: Describe this tomb.
Questions.A: It was a cave with a stone laid [by someone] across the entrance. (38)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus want [some of the people] to do?
Questions.A: He wanted them to remove the stone. (39)
Questions.Alternative: What did Jesus want some of the people to do?
What did Jesus want to do?

Questions.Q: About what did Martha warn Jesus?
Questions.A: She told him that there would be a bad smell, because Lazarus had been in the tomb for four days. (39)

Questions.Q: According to Jesus, what did Martha need to do in order to see how wonderful God is?/know the power that God has?
Questions.A: She needed to believe [in him]. (40)

Questions.Q: What did the people do?
Questions.A: They removed the stone. (41)

Questions.Q: For what did Jesus thank the Father?
Questions.A: He thanked the Father for listening to him. (41)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that he said that to his Father?
Questions.A: He said that because he wanted the people there to hear him, and, as a result, believe that God the Father had sent him. (42)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell Lazarus to do?
Questions.A: He told him to come out of the tomb. (43)

Questions.Q: What happened then?
Questions.A: Lazarus, who had been dead, came out of the tomb. (44)

Questions.Q: How did he look?
Questions.A: There were grave cloths around his hands and feet, and there was a cloth around his face. (44)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell the people to do?
Questions.A: He told them to take off the grave clothes and let him go. (44)

Section.heading: John 11:45-57 The Jewish council made plans to kill Jesus.

Questions.Q: What did the Jewish leaders want to do to Jesus?
Questions.A: They wanted to kill him. (53)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that many of the Jews believed in Jesus?
Questions.A: They believed in Jesus because they saw what Jesus did. (45)

Questions.Q: What did other Jews do?
Questions.A: They went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus did. (46)

Questions.Q: What did the chief priests and the Pharisees do?
Questions.A: They organized a meeting of the Sanhedrin [Jewish leaders]. (47)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that they were very concerned?
Questions.A: They were concerned because Jesus was doing many miraculous signs. (47)

Questions.Q: What did they think would happen if they allowed Jesus to continue [doing miraculous signs]?
Questions.A: They thought that everyone would trust/believe in Jesus.
Then the Romans would come and destroy their temple and their nation. (48)
Questions.Alternative: What did they think would happen if they allowed Jesus to continue doing miraculous signs?
What did they think would happen if they allowed Jesus to continue?

Questions.Q: Who was Caiaphas?
Questions.A: He was the high priest that year. (49)

Questions.Q: What do you know about the high priest?
Questions.A: Key Term Check: He was the one supreme priest, that is, the chief of all the priests who was chosen for a special function.
Questions.Note: See "high priest" in KBT.

Questions.Q: What did he say to those other leaders?
Questions.A: He told them that they did not know anything/understand Jesus/understand all about this affair concerning Jesus. (49)

Questions.Q: What did Caiaphas say would be the best thing to happen?
Questions.A: He said it would be better for one man to die for the people than for the whole nation to perish. (50)

Questions.Q: How did Caiaphas think up what he had just said?
Questions.A: He did not think it up on his own, [he was inspired by God to say it]/[God caused him to know that]. (51)

Questions.Q: What did Caiaphas prophesy when he said those words?
Questions.A: He prophesied that Jesus would die for the Jewish nation. (51)

Questions.Q: What do you think it means when someone prophesies?
Questions.A: Key Term Check: It means that a person will speak a direct message from God or proclaim a message inspired by God. (See "prophesy" in KBT in the "prophet" entry.)

Questions.Q: For whom else was Jesus going to die?
Questions.A: Jesus would die for all the scattered children of God/those who would believe him in many countries. (52)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus want to accomplish by dying for all those people?
Questions.A: He wanted to bring the Jewish people and all other children of God [those who would believe him] together and make them one group. (52)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus do then?
Questions.A: He stopped traveling publicly among the Jews. (54)
He went to a village/town called Ephraim near the desert and stayed there with his disciples. (54)

Questions.Q: What event was about to begin?
Questions.A: The Jewish Passover was about to begin. // The Jewish people were about to observe the Feast of Passover. (55)

Questions.Q: What did many people do before the Passover began?
Questions.A: They went to Jerusalem to purify themselves ceremonially/to do as their elders taught them to do in order to worship God. (55)
Questions.Note: Before a Jew could attend any feast he had to be ceremonially clean. So many of the Jews went up to the city early, so that they might make the necessary offerings and go through the necessary washings to ensure ceremonial cleanness.

Questions.Q: For whom were the people looking?
Questions.A: They were looking for Jesus. (56)

Questions.Q: What did they ask each other about Jesus?
Questions.A: They asked each other if Jesus/he would be coming/was coming to the [Passover] feast or not. (56)

Questions.Q: What orders had the chief priests and the Pharisees given to the people?
Questions.A: They told the people that, if anyone knew where Jesus was, he must report it to them. (57)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that they wanted the people to report to them where he was?
Questions.A: They wanted to know because they wanted to arrest him. (57)

Section.heading: John 12:1-11 Mary anointed Jesus's feet with some expensive perfume.

Questions.Q: What did Mary do according to these verses?
Questions.A: She poured some expensive perfume on Jesus's feet.
Then she wiped his feet with her hair. (3)
Questions.Note: In the Greek it says that she anointed his feet.

Questions.Q: What do you think it means to anoint someone?
Questions.A: Key Term Check: There are several different purposes for anointing someone. In this particular instance/case, Mary put the perfume on Jesus's feet to honor him.
Questions.Note: See "anoint" in KBT.

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Judas thought that what she did was wrong?
Questions.A: He thought that [someone] should have sold the perfume and given the money to the poor. (5)

Questions.Q: When did Jesus arrive at Bethany?
Questions.A: He arrived six days before the Passover began. (1)

Questions.Q: What do we already know about Bethany?
Questions.A: It was (the village) where Lazarus lived. He was the man Jesus had raised from the dead. (1)

Questions.Q: What did [some people] do for Jesus at Bethany?
Questions.A: They served a meal to honor him. (2)
Questions.Alternative: What did some people do for Jesus at Bethany?
What did do for Jesus at Bethany?

Questions.Q: What did Martha do at the meal?
Questions.A: She helped serve the meal [to the people]. (2)

Questions.Q: What did Lazarus do at the meal?
Questions.A: He was reclining at the table with Jesus. // He ate at the table with Jesus. (2)

Questions.Q: Of what was the perfume made?
Questions.A: It was made of pure nard. (3)

Questions.Q: Where could the people smell the fragrance of the perfume?
Questions.A: They could smell it all over the house. (3)

Questions.Q: Who was Judas Iscariot?
Questions.A: He was one of Jesus's disciples,
the one who would betray him. (4)

Questions.Q: How much was the perfume worth?
Questions.A: It was worth the amount that a person could earn working for one year. (5)
Questions.Note: In the Greek, the amount was 300 denarii. A working-class man could earn that average amount in one year.

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Judas said that?
Questions.A: He said that because he was a thief. He did not care about the poor. (6)

Questions.Q: What job/responsibility did Judas have?
Questions.A: He was in charge of the money bag for the disciples. // He was the treasurer for them. (6)
Questions.Alternative: What job did Judas have?
What responsibility did Judas have?

Questions.Q: What did he do with the money that was in the money bag?
Questions.A: He stole from it. // He would help himself to it. (6)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell Judas?
Questions.A: He told Judas to leave her alone. (7)

Questions.Q: According to Jesus, for what should she have saved this perfume?
Questions.A: She should have saved it for the day when people would bury him. (7)

Questions.Q: Whom did the disciples always have with them?
Questions.A: They always had the poor people. (8)

Questions.Q: Whom did they have for only a limited time?
Questions.A: They had Jesus for only a limited time. (8)
Questions.Alternative: Whom did they have, physically, with them for only a limited time?
Whom did they have with them for only a limited time?
Whom would they not always have with them?

Questions.Q: What is the reason that a large crowd [of people] came to Bethany?
Questions.A: A large crowd came to Bethany because they learned/found out that Jesus was there
and also they wanted to see Lazarus. (9)
Questions.Alternative: What is the reason that a large crowd of people came to Bethany?
What is the reason that a large crowd came to Bethany?

Questions.Q: Besides planning to kill Jesus, what other plans did the chief priests make?
Questions.A: They planned to kill Lazarus too. (10)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that the chief priests wanted to kill Lazarus?
Questions.A: They wanted to kill him because on account of him many of the Jews were leaving their leaders' teachings and believing in Jesus. (11)

Section.heading: John 12:12-19 A large crowd praised Jesus as he entered Jerusalem. // Jesus entered Jerusalem like a king.

Questions.Q: According to these verses, what did the people do for Jesus?
Questions.A: They took palm branches and went out to meet him.
They praised God [as they led Jesus into Jerusalem]. (12-13)

Questions.Q: Who heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem?
Questions.A: The large crowd that had come to the [Passover] feast heard that Jesus was coming. (12)

Questions.Q: When did they hear that?
Questions.A: They heard it the next day. (12)

Questions.Q: On what animal did Jesus ride/sit?
Questions.A: He rode/sat on a young donkey. (14)
Questions.Alternative: On what animal did Jesus ride?
On what animal did Jesus sit?

Questions.Q: What was fulfilled when he did that?
Questions.A: His act fulfilled what [someone] had written in the scripture [Old Testament]. (14)
Questions.Note: This was a quote from Zechariah 9:9.

Questions.Q: On what animal would Zion's king ride?
Questions.A: He would ride on a donkey's colt/a young donkey. (15)

Questions.Q: What did his disciples remember after [God] glorified Jesus [when Jesus was resurrected by God and had returned to heaven]?
Questions.A: They remembered that [someone] had written those things about him [in the scriptures],
and that they had done those things to him. (16)
Questions.Alternative: What did his disciples remember when Jesus was resurrected by God and had returned to heaven?
What did his disciples remember after God glorified Jesus?
What did his disciples remember after Jesus was glorified and had returned to heaven?
What did his disciples remember after Jesus was glorified?
What did his disciples remember when Jesus had risen from the dead and returned to heaven?

Questions.Q: What had the crowd, that was with Jesus, done?
Questions.A: They continued to tell others that Jesus had raised Lazarus from the dead. (17)

Questions.Q: What was the result of this miraculous sign that Jesus did?
Questions.A: Many people went out to meet him as he was approaching Jerusalem. (18)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that the Pharisees said that they were not succeeding/not able to arrest Jesus?
Questions.A: They said that because many people were following Jesus. Therefore, the Pharisees had no opportunity to arrest him. (19)
Questions.Alternative: What is the reason that the Pharisees said that they were not succeeding able to arrest Jesus?
What is the reason that the Pharisees said that they were not not able to arrest Jesus?

Section.heading: John 12:20-36 Jesus predicted his coming death. // Jesus told people that he was going to die.

Questions.Q: What did Jesus say was going to happen to him?
Questions.A: He said the hour had come when [God] would show how wonderful the Son of Man/Jesus is. (23)
He was going to be lifted up [by God] from the earth to heaven. // [God] was going to lift him [Jesus] up from the earth to heaven. (32)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that some Greeks went [to Jerusalem]?
Questions.A: They went there to worship [God] during the feast. (20)
Questions.Alternative: What is the reason that some Greeks went to Jerusalem?
What is the reason that some Greeks went?

Questions.Q: From where was Philip? // What was the name of Philip's hometown?
Questions.A: He was from Bethsaida [town] in Galilee. // His hometown was Bethsaida in Galilee. (21)
Questions.Alternative: From where was Philip?
What was the name of Philip's hometown?

Questions.Q: What request did the Greeks make of Philip?
Questions.A: They told him that they wanted to see Jesus. (21)

Questions.Q: What did Philip and Andrew tell Jesus?
Questions.A: They told him that some Greeks wanted to see him. (22)

Questions.Q: What happens to a kernel of wheat which is not planted in the ground [by someone]?
Questions.A: It will continue to be a single seed. (24)
Questions.Alternative: What happens to a kernel of wheat which is not planted in the ground by someone?
What happens to a kernel of wheat which is not planted in the ground?

Questions.Q: What happens to a kernel of wheat which is planted in the ground [by someone]?
Questions.A: It sprouts and produces many seeds. (24)
Questions.Alternative: What happens to a kernel of wheat which is planted in the ground by someone?
What happens to a kernel of wheat which is planted in the ground?

Questions.Q: What will happen to a person who loves the way he lives and loves the things he does?
Questions.A: He will not have eternal life/not always be [with God]. (25)
Questions.Alternative: What will happen to a person who loves his own way of living, and holds on to the things he does?

Questions.Q: What will happen to a person who does not love just to do his own desires?
Questions.A: He will have eternal life [with God]. (25)

Questions.Q: What must a person do, if he wants to serve Jesus?
Questions.A: He must follow Jesus/believe Jesus/become Jesus's disciple. (26)

Questions.Q: What will be the result of doing that?
Questions.A: That person will always be with Jesus. (26)

Questions.Q: Whom does God the Father honor?
Questions.A: He honors a person who serves Jesus. (26)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus pray to the Father?
Questions.A: He told him that his heart was troubled. (27)
Should he ask him to save him from this time of [suffering]? (27)
He said it was for that reason that he came to that hour. (27)

Questions.Q: What do you think it means that Jesus's heart/soul was troubled?
Questions.A: Key Term Check: In the Greek "soul" is used in place of "heart" which NIV uses. Depending on the context, "soul" in this sense refers to a person's ambitions, desires, or feelings, or his life in relationship to God.
Questions.Note: See "soul" in KBT.
Questions.Alternative: What do you think it means that Jesus's heart was troubled?
What do you think it means that Jesus's soul was troubled?

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell the Father to do?
Questions.A: He told him to glorify his [own] name/to show to people that he (God) is powerful/to show to people how wonderful God is]. (28)

Questions.Q: What did a voice from heaven say?
Questions.A: God/It said, "I have glorified it, and will glorify it again." (28)

Questions.Q: What did the crowd say about the voice they heard?
Questions.A: Some of them said it thundered. (29)
Other people said that an angel had spoken to him/Jesus. (29)

Questions.Q: For whose benefit had God/the voice spoken?
Questions.A: God/It spoke for the benefit of the people who were there. (30)
Questions.Alternative: For whose benefit had God spoken?
For whose benefit had the voice spoken?

Questions.Q: What was going to happen to the world?
Questions.A: [God] will punish those who do not believe him. (31)

Questions.Q: What was going to happen to the prince of this world?
Questions.A: He was going to/will be defeated [by God]. (31)

Questions.Q: Who do you think the "prince of this world" is?
Questions.A: Key Term Check: This is another term that refers to Satan. (See "prince of this world" in KBT in the "Satan" entry.)

Questions.Q: What was Jesus going/about to do?
Questions.A: He was going/about to draw all men to himself. // He was going to cause all men to come to him. (32)
Questions.Alternative: What was Jesus going to do?
What was Jesus about to do?

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Jesus said this?
Questions.A: He said it to show how he was to die. (33)
Questions.Alternative: Why did Jesus say this?
What was Jesus intending to communicate when he said this?

Questions.Q: What is the reason that the people were confused?
Questions.A: They were confused because the law stated that the Messiah would live forever,
so how could he say that "the Son of Man must die/be lifted up?" (34)
Questions.Alternative: What is the reason that the people were confused about Jesus' words?
Why were the people confused about Jesus' words?
Why were the people confused?
Why were the people confused by what Jesus said?

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell them about the light?
Questions.A: They would have the light a little while longer. (35)

Questions.Q: What did he tell them to do?
Questions.A: They should live their lives while they have the light so that darkness does not come upon them. (35)

Questions.Q: What is the situation of a person who walks in the dark?
Questions.A: He does not know/cannot see where he is going. (35)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell those people to do?
Questions.A: He told them to put their trust in the light while they had it. (36)

Questions.Q: What would be the result of that?
Questions.A: They would belong to him/become sons of light. (36)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus do after he finished talking?
Questions.A: He left and hid himself from them. (36)

Section.heading: John 12:37-50 The Jews/people did not believe in Jesus, even after he performed many miracles. // Jesus did many miracles, but people still did not believe in him.

Questions.Q: According to Isaiah, why were those people not able to believe?
Questions.A: God had blinded their eyes and deadened their hearts. // God had caused them not to understand what they saw and what they heard. (39-40)

Questions.Q: What was the response of those people who had seen his miraculous signs?
Questions.A: They did not believe in him. (37)

Questions.Q: What was fulfilled by the people, when they did not believe in Jesus?
Questions.A: The things the prophet Isaiah had said were fulfilled. // Isaiah's prophecies were fulfilled. // They were the fulfillment of Isaiah's prophecies. (38)

Questions.Q: What had Isaiah said?
Questions.A: He said, "Lord, who has believed our message and to whom has the power of God been revealed?" (38)

Questions.Q: What could those people not do after God blinded their eyes and deadened their hearts?
Questions.A: They could not see with their eyes/did not understand what they saw,
nor understand what they heard/with their hearts
nor turn [to God] so that he could save/heal them. (40)
Questions.Alternative: What could those people not do after their eyes were blinded and their hearts were deadened?

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Isaiah spoke about God in this way?
Questions.A: He spoke about God in this way because he saw ahead of time the glory that Jesus would have later. (41)
Questions.Alternative: What is the reason that Isaiah prophesied these words?
Why did Isaiah prophesy in this way?
Why did Isaiah speak about God in this way?
Why did Isaiah speak in this way?
Why did Isaiah speak to God in this way?
Why did Isaiah prophesy these words?
How could Isaiah prophesy in this way?

Questions.Q: Who were among those who believed in Jesus?
Questions.A: Many of the [Jewish] leaders believed in him. (42)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that they would not confess that they believed [in him]?
Questions.A: They did not openly confess because they were afraid the Pharisees would put them out of the synagogue. (42)
Questions.Alternative: What is the reason that they would not confess that they believed in him?
What is the reason that they would not confess that they believed?

Questions.Q: What did those people/Jewish leaders love more?
Questions.A: They loved praise from men more than praise from God. (43)
Questions.Alternative: What did those people love more?
What did those Jewish leaders love more?

Questions.Q: When a person believes in Jesus, in whom else does he believe?
Questions.A: He believes in the one who sent him. (44)

Questions.Q: When a person sees Jesus, who else does he see?
Questions.A: He sees the one who sent him. (45)

Questions.Q: What happens to a person who believes in Jesus, the light?
Questions.A: He will not stay in darkness. (46)

Questions.Q: What does Jesus do to the person who hears his words, but does not keep them?
Questions.A: Jesus does not judge that person at that time. (47)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Jesus came to the world?
Questions.A: He came to the world to save people. (47)

Questions.Q: What will happen to a person who rejects Jesus and does not accept his words?
Questions.A: The words that Jesus spoke will judge that person on the last day [when God judges people]. (48)

Questions.Q: Who told Jesus what he should say and how he should say it?
Questions.A: His Father who sent him told him. (49)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus say that he knew about the Father's command?
Questions.A: His command leads to eternal life. (50)

Questions.Q: What is true about the things that Jesus said/says?
Questions.A: What is true is that those things are what the Father has told him to say. (50)
Questions.Alternative: What is true about the things that Jesus said?
What is true about the things that Jesus says?

Section.heading: John 13:1-17 Jesus washed his disciples' feet.

Questions.Q: According to these verses, what did Jesus do to his disciples?
Questions.A: He washed his disciples' feet. (5, 14)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell his disciples to do?
Questions.A: He told them that they should wash one another's feet. (14)

Questions.Q: How many more days were there before the Passover Feast would begin?
Questions.A: It was the day before the Passover Feast. (1)

Questions.Q: Where was Jesus preparing to go?
Questions.A: He was preparing to leave this world and go to the Father. (1)

Questions.Q: What was Jesus's attitude toward his people?
Questions.A: He had always loved them. (1)

Questions.Q: What attitude did Jesus show toward his own?
Questions.A: He loved them completely. (1)

Questions.Q: What activity took place in this sequence?
Questions.A: [Jesus and his disciples] were eating supper/the evening meal. (2)
Questions.Note: The subjects are implied from the context of the passage.

Questions.Q: What had the devil done?
Questions.A: He had put the thought into the mind/heart of Judas to betray Jesus. (2)

Questions.Q: Who was Judas?
Questions.A: He was the son of Simon Iscariot. (2)

Questions.Q: What things did Jesus know about his own relationship to God?
Questions.A: The Father had put all things under his power.
He had come from God.
He was returning to God. (3)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus do [after they had eaten]?
Questions.A: He got up from the meal/table.
He removed his outer clothing.
He tied a towel around his waist. (4)
Questions.Alternative: What did Jesus do after they had eaten?
What did Jesus do?

Questions.Q: What did he do after he washed their feet?
Questions.A: He dried their feet with the towel that was wrapped around his waist. (5)

Questions.Q: What did Simon Peter ask Jesus?
Questions.A: He asked, "Lord, are you going to wash my feet?" (6)

Questions.Q: What was Jesus's answer to Peter?
Questions.A: Jesus said, "You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand." (7)

Questions.Q: What did Peter tell Jesus?
Questions.A: He told Jesus that he would never allow him to wash his feet. (8)

Questions.Q: According to Jesus, what did he need to do so that Peter would be his disciple?
Questions.A: It was necessary that Jesus wash his feet. (8)

Questions.Q: What did Peter want Jesus to wash?
Questions.A: He wanted him to wash his hands and head, as well as his feet. (9)

Questions.Q: What does a person need to wash, if he has already had a bath?
Questions.A: He needs to wash his feet. (10)

Questions.Q: How many of the disciples there were not clean/did not have good hearts?
Questions.A: One of them was not clean/did not have a good heart. (10)
Questions.Alternative: How many of the disciples there were not clean?
How many of the disciples there did not have good hearts?

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Jesus said that one of them had a bad heart?
Questions.A: He said that because he knew who was going to betray him. (11)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus do after he washed their feet?
Questions.A: He put on his outer clothing.
He returned to his place [at the table]. (12)

Questions.Q: What did he ask them/his disciples?
Questions.A: He asked them if they understood what he had just done for them. (12)
Questions.Alternative: What did he ask them?
What did he ask his disciples?

Questions.Q: What did those disciples call Jesus?
Questions.A: They called him "Teacher" and "Lord." (13)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus say about their calling him that?
Questions.A: He said that it was right for them to call him that. (13)

Questions.Q: What was Jesus's relationship to those men?
Questions.A: He was their Lord and Teacher. (14)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Jesus set this example for them?
Questions.A: He set this example because he wanted them to do what he had done. (15)

Questions.Q: Who is greater the servant or the master?
Questions.A: The master is greater/more important. (16)

Questions.Q: Who is greater, the messenger or the one who sent him?
Questions.A: The one who sent him is greater/more important. (16)

Questions.Q: What will happen to the disciples, if they did the things about which Jesus had been talking?
Questions.A: They will be looked on well by God. // God will look well on them. // They would be blessed [by God]. (17)

Section.heading: John 13:18-30 Jesus told his disciples that one of them will betray him.

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell the disciples that one of them was going to do to him?
Questions.A: He told them that one of the disciples was going to betray him. (21)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus say to his disciples?
Questions.A: He said that he was not referring to all of them. (18)
He said that he knew the ones he had chosen. (18)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell his disciples that must come true?
Questions.A: He said the scripture that says "The man who ate my food turned against me." // "One who ate with me is my enemy." // "The man who ate my food turned against me." must come true. (18)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Jesus quoted this scripture to them before the event happened?
Questions.A: He told them, so that when it did happen, they would believe that Jesus was the Messiah. (19)

Questions.Q: If a person receives someone, whom Jesus has sent, whom else is he also receiving?
Questions.A: He is receiving Jesus. (20)

Questions.Q: If a person receives Jesus, whom is he also receiving?
Questions.A: He is receiving the one who sent Jesus. (20)

Questions.Q: How was Jesus's feeling at this time?
Questions.A: He was deeply troubled. (21)

Questions.Q: About what were the disciples puzzled?
Questions.A: They wondered which one of them would betray him. (22)

Questions.Q: Who was sitting next to Jesus?
Questions.A: The disciple, whom Jesus loved, was seated next to him. (23)

Questions.Q: What did Simon Peter say to the disciple sitting next to Jesus?
Questions.A: He told him to ask Jesus which one [of them] he meant. (24)

Questions.Q: What did that disciple ask Jesus?
Questions.A: He asked him who it was/[who was going to betray him]. (25)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell him?
Questions.A: He told him it was the one to whom he would give the piece of bread after he had dipped it in the dish. (26)

Questions.Q: To whom did Jesus give the piece of bread?
Questions.A: He gave it/the piece of bread to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon. (26)

Questions.Q: What happened to Judas, as soon as he had received/taken the bread?
Questions.A: Satan went into him. // Satan controlled him. (27)
Questions.Alternative: What happened to Judas, as soon as he had received the bread?
What happened to Judas, as soon as he had taken the bread?

Questions.Q: What did Jesus say then to Judas?
Questions.A: Jesus told him, "What you are about to do, do quickly." (27)

Questions.Q: Which of the disciples understood why Jesus had said that to Judas?
Questions.A: None of them understood that. (28)

Questions.Q: What responsibility did Judas have?
Questions.A: He was in charge of the disciples' money bag/box. (29)

Questions.Q: What did some of the disciples think that Jesus was telling Judas to do?
Questions.A: Some of them thought he was telling Judas to go buy what they needed for the feast, or to give something to the poor. (29)

Questions.Q: What did Judas do?
Questions.A: He took the bread and then went out at once. (30)

Section.heading: John 13:31-38 Jesus told his disciples to love one another. // Jesus told Peter that he will deny him three times.

Questions.Q: What new commandment did Jesus tell them?
Questions.A: He told them [the command] to love one another. (34)

Questions.Q: What do you think a commandment is?
Questions.A: Key Term Check: It is a definite and official order given by one person to another to carry out.

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell Peter to indicate that Peter was not ready to die for Jesus?
Questions.A: Jesus told Peter that he would disown Jesus three times before the rooster crowed. (38)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell the disciples?
Questions.A: He told them that now the Son of Man will be honored [by God]. // He told them that now [God] will show how wonderful the Son of Man is. (31-32)
Also he told them that God will be honored by him. // Also he told them that the Son of Man, will show how wonderful God is. (31-32)

Questions.Q: How long did Jesus tell them he would be with them?
Questions.A: He said that he would be with them a little while longer. (33)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell his disciples that he had also told the Jews?
Questions.A: They would look for him, but that they would not be able to go where he was going. (33)

Questions.Q: In what way were they to love one another?
Questions.A: They were to love one another in the way that he had loved them. (34)

Questions.Q: What would be the result, if Jesus's disciples loved one another?
Questions.A: The result would be that all men would know that they were Jesus's disciples. (35)

Questions.Q: What did Simon Peter ask Jesus?
Questions.A: He asked him where he was going. (36)

Questions.Q: What was Jesus's answer?
Questions.A: He told Peter that he could not follow him now to the place where he was going, but later he would follow him there. (36)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Peter thought that he could follow Jesus now?
Questions.A: He thought that because he said that he was ready to die for Jesus. (37)

Section.heading: John 14:1-4 Jesus told his disciples not to be troubled or worried. // Jesus told his disciples that he was going to his Father's house to prepare a place for them.

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell [the disciples] not to do?
Questions.A: He told them not to let their hearts be troubled. // He told them that they should not be worried or upset. (1)
Questions.Alternative: What did Jesus tell the disciples not to do?
What did Jesus tell not to do?

Questions.Q: What did he tell his disciples to do?
Questions.A: He told them to trust in God and to trust him. (1)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus say about his Father's house?
Questions.A: He said there are many rooms in it. (2)

Questions.Q: What was Jesus going to do when he went to his Father's house?
Questions.A: He was going to prepare a place for them. (2)

Questions.Q: What was Jesus going to do after he prepared a place for them?
Questions.A: He was going to come back and take them to be with him. (3)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that he was going to do that?
Questions.A: He was going to do that so that they would be where he would be. (3)

Questions.Q: According to Jesus, what did the disciples already know?
Questions.A: They already knew the way to the place where he was going. (4)

Section.heading: John 14:5-15 Jesus told his disciples that he is the way to the Father/God.

Questions.Q: What did Jesus say about himself?
Questions.A: He said he is the way [to heaven].
He told the truth.
[He is the source of eternal] life.
No one comes to the Father except through him. (6)
He said that anyone, who has seen him, has seen the Father. (9)

Questions.Q: What two things did Thomas say that they did not know?
Questions.A: He said that they did not know where Jesus was going,
so how could they know the way to go there? (5)

Questions.Q: If they really knew Jesus, whom else would they also know?
Questions.A: They would also know his Father. (7)

Questions.Q: What else did Jesus tell them about their relationship to the Father?
Questions.A: He told them that, from now on, they did know him,
and they had seen him. (7)

Questions.Q: What did Philip ask Jesus?
Questions.A: He asked Jesus to show them the Father. (8)

Questions.Q: If Jesus showed the Father to them, what else did they want?
Questions.A: They did not want anything more; that would be enough for them. (8)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus ask Philip?
Questions.A: He asked him whether/if he still did not know him, after the long time he had been among them. (9)

Questions.Q: What else did Jesus ask Philip?
Questions.A: He asked him how he could say, "Show us the Father." (9)

Questions.Q: What other question did Jesus ask Philip?
Questions.A: He asked him if he did not believe that he [Jesus] was in the Father and that the Father was in him. (10)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus say about the words he said to Philip?
Questions.A: He said those words were not just his own words, but they were from the Father. (10)
Questions.Alternative: What did Jesus say about his words?
What did Jesus say about the things he spoke?
What did Jesus say about the things he spoke to Philip?
What did Jesus say about the source of his words?

Questions.Q: Who is doing his (the Father's) work?
Questions.A: The Father, who is living in Jesus, is doing his work. (10)
Questions.Alternative: Who is doing the work through Jesus?
Who was doing the work through Jesus?
Who was doing his work?

Questions.Q: What did Jesus want the disciples to believe?
Questions.A: He wanted them to believe that he was in the Father and that the Father was in him. (11)

Questions.Q: If they did not believe this, on what basis did he want them to believe him?
Questions.A: They should believe because of the miracles [he did]. (11)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus say about anyone who had faith in him?
Questions.A: He said that they will do what Jesus had been doing.
They will do even greater works/things than those that he had done. (12)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that they would be able to do greater works/things?
Questions.A: They would be able to do greater works because Jesus was going to the Father. (12)
Questions.Alternative: What is the reason that they would be able to do greater works?
What is the reason that they would be able to do greater things?

Questions.Q: What promise did Jesus make to them?
Questions.A: He promised that he would do whatever they asked for in his name. (13-14)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that he will do that?
Questions.A: He will do that so that the Son will honor the Father. (13)

Questions.Q: What will a person do who loves Jesus?
Questions.A: He will do what Jesus commands him to do. (15)

Section.heading: John 14:16-31 Jesus told his disciples that the Father will send the Holy Spirit to help them. // Jesus promised that God will send the Holy Spirit.

Questions.Q: Whom will the Father send to the disciples?
Questions.A: He will send the Counselor/the Holy Spirit. (26)

Questions.Q: What will the Holy Spirit do after the Father sends him?
Questions.A: He will teach them everything.
He will remind them of all the things Jesus had told them. (26)

Questions.Q: What will Jesus ask the Father to do?
Questions.A: He will ask him to give them another Counselor. (16)

Questions.Q: Who is this Counselor?
Questions.A: He is the Spirit of truth. // He is the one who always tells the truth. (17)

Questions.Q: How long will he be with them?
Questions.A: He will be with them forever. (17)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that people of the world can not accept this Counselor?
Questions.A: They can not accept this Counselor because they do not see him, and they do not know him. (17)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that the disciples knew this Counselor?
Questions.A: The disciples knew this Counselor because he lived with them and will be in them. (17)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus promise his disciples?
Questions.A: He promised that he would not leave them as orphans. (18)
He promised that he would come to them. (18)

Questions.Q: Whom will people of the world not see anymore?
Questions.A: They will not see Jesus. (19)

Questions.Q: Who will see him?
Questions.A: The disciples will see him. (19)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that they will live [eternally]?
Questions.A: They will live [eternally] because he was living. (19)
Questions.Alternative: What is the reason that they will live eternally?
What is the reason that they will live?

Questions.Q: What will they know?
Questions.A: They will know that Jesus is in the Father/belonged to the Father.
and that the disciples are in Jesus/belonged to Jesus.
and that Jesus is in them/belonged to them. (20)

Questions.Q: Who is the person that loves Jesus? // Who loves Jesus? // What kind of person loves Jesus?
Questions.A: He is the one who obeys Jesus's commandments. // The one who obeys Jesus's commandments is the one who loves Jesus. (21, 23)
Questions.Alternative: Who is the person that loves Jesus?
Who loves Jesus?
What kind of person loves Jesus?

Questions.Q: Whom does the Father love?
Questions.A: He loves any person who loves Jesus. (21, 23)

Questions.Q: What will Jesus do for that person?
Questions.A: He will love him and show himself to him. (21)

Questions.Q: What did Judas ask Jesus?
Questions.A: He asked him why he was going to show himself to them and not to the people of the world. (22)

Questions.Q: What will the Father and Jesus do for the person who loves Jesus?
Questions.A: They will come to him and fellowship/live with him. (23)

Questions.Q: What is true of a person who does not love Jesus?
Questions.A: He does not obey what Jesus taught. (24)

Questions.Q: What is the source of Jesus's words/message?
Questions.A: Jesus's words/message belong to the Father, who sent him. (24)
Questions.Alternative: What is the source of Jesus's words?
What is the source of Jesus's message?

Questions.Q: When did he tell them all those words?
Questions.A: He told them while he was still with them. (25)

Questions.Q: What quality/characteristic did Jesus want his disciples to have?
Questions.A: He wanted them to have peace [in their hearts]. (27)
Questions.Alternative: What quality did Jesus want his disciples to have?
What characteristic did Jesus want his disciples to have?

Questions.Q: What do you think it means to be at peace?
Questions.A: Key Term Check: To be at peace is to have a mental or spiritual condition marked by freedom from disquieting or oppressive thoughts or emotions.
Questions.Note: See "peace" in KBT.

Questions.Q: What did he tell them not to do?
Questions.A: He told them not to let their hearts be troubled and not to be afraid. (27)

Questions.Q: What had he told the disciples he was going to do?
Questions.A: He told them that he was going away but he was coming back to them. (28)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that he expected them to feel glad?
Questions.A: He expected them to be glad because he was going to the Father. (28)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Jesus told them about his departure before it happened?
Questions.A: He wanted to tell them so that, when it did happen, they would believe [in him]. (29)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Jesus did not talk with them much longer?
Questions.A: He did not talk with them much longer because the prince of this world was coming. (30)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus say about the prince of this world?
Questions.A: He said that he had no power over Jesus. (30)

Questions.Q: What did the people of the world have to learn?
Questions.A: Jesus loves the Father. (31)
He does what the Father commands him to do. (31)

Questions.Q: What did he tell the disciples to do together with him?
Questions.A: He told them to leave that place with him. (31)

Section.heading: John 15:1-17 Jesus said that he is the vine, the Father is the gardener, and his followers are the branches. // Jesus said that he is like a vine and his disciples are like branches (of the vine).

Questions.Q: What is the main thing Jesus talked about in these verses?
Questions.A: It is important [for his followers] to fellowship with him/remain in him. (4)
If a person does not remain in him, that person will not do good things/can not do anything/can not bear fruit. (4-5)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus call himself?
Questions.A: He said that he is the true vine. // Jesus called himself the true vine. (1)

Questions.Q: What did he say the Father is?
Questions.A: He said that the Father is the gardener. (1)

Questions.Q: What does the Father do?
Questions.A: He cuts off every branch in Jesus that does not bear fruit,
and prunes every branch that does bear fruit. (2)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that he prunes branches that are bearing fruit?
Questions.A: He prunes the branches so that they will bear more fruit. (2)

Questions.Q: What had made them [free from their sin]/clean?
Questions.A: The word/message Jesus had spoken to them made them [free from their sin]/clean. (3)
Questions.Alternative: What had made them free from their sin?
What had made them clean?

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell them at that time?
Questions.A: He told them to remain in him and he would remain in them. (4)

Questions.Q: What does a branch have in common with a follower of Jesus?
Questions.A: A branch cannot bear fruit unless it remains attached to the vine,
and a follower of Jesus cannot bear fruit unless he remains in fellowship with Jesus. (4)

Questions.Q: Who do the branches represent? // Who are the branches?
Questions.A: They are Jesus'/his followers. (5)
Questions.Alternative: Who do the branches represent?
Who are the branches?

Questions.Q: What must a person do to bear much fruit?
Questions.A: He must remain in fellowship with Jesus and must have Jesus remain in fellowship with him. (5)

Questions.Q: Who is like a branch that someone throws away?
Questions.A: A person who does not remain in fellowship with Jesus is like a branch that [someone] throws away. (6)

Questions.Q: What happens to branches that [someone] cuts off and throws away?
Questions.A: [Someone] gathers them up, throws them into the fire, and burns them. (6)
Questions.Alternative: What happens to branches that someone cuts off and throws away?
What happens to branches that cuts off and throws away?

Questions.Q: What should a person do to obtain/have what he needs/wants?
Questions.A: He should remain in fellowship with Jesus.
He should let Jesus's words remain in him.
Then he should ask [God] for what he needs/wants. (7)
Questions.Alternative: What should a person do to obtain what he needs?
What should a person do to obtain what he wants?
What should a person do to have what he needs?
What should a person do to have what he wants?

Questions.Q: What happens when people bear much fruit?
Questions.A: It honors the Father.
It shows that they are Jesus's disciples. (8)

Questions.Q: In what way did Jesus love his disciples?
Questions.A: He loved them in the same way that the Father loved him. (9)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell his disciples to do?
Questions.A: They should remain in fellowship with him to experience his love for them. (9)

Questions.Q: What does a disciple do to remain in Jesus's love?
Questions.A: He obeys Jesus's commands. (10)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus do to remain in his Father's love?
Questions.A: He obeyed his Father's commands. (10)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Jesus told them that?
Questions.A: He wanted them to be joyful as he was joyful. // He wanted his joy to be in them. //
He wanted them to be completely happy. // He wanted their joy to be complete. (11)

Questions.Q: In what way did Jesus want his disciples to love each other?
Questions.A: He wanted them to love in the same way that he had loved them. (12)

Questions.Q: What is the greatest love a man can have for his friends?
Questions.A: When a man is willing to die/give his life for his friends, that is the greatest love. (13)

Questions.Q: What does a person have to do to be Jesus's friend?
Questions.A: He has to do what Jesus commands. (14)

Questions.Q: What is the difference between a servant of a person and a friend of a person?
Questions.A: A servant does not know all that his master is doing,
but a master tells his friend what he is doing. (15)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus call his disciples?
Questions.A: He called them his friends. (15)

Questions.Q: What had Jesus told them?
Questions.A: He told them everything he had learned from his Father. (15)

Questions.Q: What had Jesus chosen his disciples to do?
Questions.A: He chose them to go and bear fruit that will last. (16)

Questions.Q: What would be the result of their bearing fruit?
Questions.A: The Father would give them what ever they asked of him in Jesus's name. (16)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus command them to do?
Questions.A: He commanded them to love each other/one another. (17)

Section.heading: John 15:18-27 Jesus told his disciples that, since the people of the world hated him, they will also hate them. // Jesus said that, since the people of the world hated him, they will also hate his disciples.

Questions.Q: What is the reason that people of the world hate the followers of Jesus?
Questions.A: They hate them because they hated Jesus.
Since Jesus has chosen his followers from among the people of the world, his followers no longer belong to those people of the world. (18-19)

Questions.Q: Whom do the people of the world love?
Questions.A: They love those who are their own. (19)

Questions.Q: What had Jesus told his followers before?
Questions.A: He had told them that "No servant is greater than his master." (20)

Questions.Q: How will the people of the world treat them?
Questions.A: The people of the world will treat Jesus's followers the same way they treated him. (20)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that the people of the world persecute the followers of Jesus?
Questions.A: They persecute Jesus's followers because they belong to Jesus
and because they do not know the one who sent Jesus. (21)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that the people of the world do not have any excuse for their sin?
Questions.A: They have no excuse because Jesus came and spoke to them. (22)

Questions.Q: If someone hates Jesus, whom does he also hate?
Questions.A: He also hates Jesus's Father. (23)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that the people of the world are guilty of sin?
Questions.A: They are guilty of sin because they did not believe the miracles which Jesus did among them which no one else had ever done. (24)

Questions.Q: What was their response to the miracles which they saw?
Questions.A: They hated Jesus and his Father. (24)

Questions.Q: Which part of their law was fulfilled as a result of their hatred?
Questions.A: The part of their law that was fulfilled, reads/said, "They hated me without reason." (25)

Questions.Q: What will the Counselor or the Spirit of truth do when he comes to them?
Questions.A: He will testify about Jesus. (26)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell his followers they should do when the Spirit comes to them?
Questions.A: He told them they must also testify [about him]. (27)
Questions.Alternative: What did Jesus tell his followers they should do when the Spirit of truth comes to them?

Questions.Q: What is the reason that they could do that?
Questions.A: They would be able to do that because they had been with Jesus from the beginning of his ministry. (27)

Section.heading: John 16:1-15 Jesus said that he must go away, so that he could/can send the Holy Spirit to them to help them. // Jesus said that he must die, or the Holy Spirit cannot come. // Jesus explained how the Holy Spirit will work in people's hearts.

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Jesus told the disciples about things that were going to happen?
Questions.A: He told them about those things because he did not want them to go astray or fall away [from believing in him]. (1)

Questions.Q: About what did Jesus warn his disciples?
Questions.A: He warned them that people will put them out of the synagogue and kill them. (2)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Jesus had to go away?
Questions.A: He had to go away because the Counselor would not come until he went away. (7)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that the people will do those things?
Questions.A: They will do those things because they do not know the Father or Jesus. (3)

Questions.Q: When did Jesus hope that they would remember that he had warned them about those things?
Questions.A: When the people did those things to them, he wanted them to remember that he had warned them. (4)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Jesus did not tell them about those things earlier?
Questions.A: He had not told them earlier because he was still with them. (4)

Questions.Q: Where was Jesus going?
Questions.A: He was going to the one who had sent him. (5)

Questions.Q: What had the disciples not asked Jesus?
Questions.A: They did not ask him where he was going. (5)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that the disciples were feeling grief?
Questions.A: They grieved because Jesus had told them those things. (6)

Questions.Q: Who was going to send the Counselor to them?
Questions.A: Jesus was going to send the Counselor to them. (7)

Questions.Q: What will the Counselor prove to the people of the world?
Questions.A: He will prove that they are sinners. // They have the wrong idea about sin.
God/Jesus is righteous.
God will punish people who do not believe Jesus. (8)

Questions.Q: What do you think it means for someone to be righteous?
Questions.A: Key Term Check: It means that a person is in a state of having been accepted by God as right in God's eyes. In this reference it refers to the fact that Christ was in the right with God. (See "righteousness" in KBT in the "just, justify..." entry.)

Questions.Q: What do you think judgment means?
Questions.A: Key Term Check: It means that someone assesses something as either good or bad. He considers the facts and reaches a conclusion. (See "judgment" in KBT in the "judge" entry.)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that the people of the world are wrong about sin?
Questions.A: They are wrong about sin, because they do not believe in Jesus. (9)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that they were wrong about righteousness?
Questions.A: They were wrong about righteousness because Jesus was going to the Father. (10)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that they were wrong about judgment?
Questions.A: They were wrong about judgment, because [God] has already judged the ruler of this world. (11)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Jesus did not tell the disciples the other words/messages he had for them?
Questions.A: He did not tell them the other words/messages because it would have been too much for them to bear. (12)
Questions.Alternative: What is the reason that Jesus did not tell the disciples the other words he had for them?
What is the reason that Jesus did not tell the disciples the other messages he had for them?

Questions.Q: What would the Spirit of truth do when he came?
Questions.A: He would guide them into all the truth. (13)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus say about the authority of the Spirit of truth?
Questions.A: He would not speak on his own, but would tell only what he heard. (13)
Questions.Alternative: What did Jesus say about the Spirit of truth? Where does He speak from?
What did Jesus say about the source of the words the Spirit of truth would speak?
What did Jesus say about the words the Spirit of truth would speak?

Questions.Q: What will he tell them?
Questions.A: He will tell them about the things that will happen in the future. (13)

Questions.Q: How will the Spirit of truth honor Jesus?
Questions.A: He will honor Jesus by telling them about Jesus. (14)

Questions.Q: What was the relationship of Jesus to the Father?
Questions.A: All that the Father had, also belonged to Jesus. // Everything that was the Father's, also belonged to Jesus. (15)

Questions.Q: Who will tell them what he had heard from Jesus?
Questions.A: The Spirit of truth will tell them. (15)

Section.heading: John 16:16-33 Jesus told his disciples that they will grieve, but later they will become joyful.

Questions.Q: What will happen to the disciples when they grieve?
Questions.A: They will have a time when they are joyful. (20)
Questions.Alternative: What will happen to the disciples after they grieve?
What did Jesus say would happen to the disciples after they grieved?
What did Jesus say would happen after the disciples had grieved?
What did Jesus say would happen after the disciples time of sorrow?

Questions.Q: With what did Jesus compare the disciples' grief?
Questions.A: He compared it to the pain of a woman who is about to give birth to a child. (21-22)

Questions.Q: In what ways are the disciples and a woman about to give birth the same?
Questions.A: They were grieving/anguishing at the time, but they would be joyful later/in the future. (21-22)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell the disciples about the time when they would see him?
Questions.A: He told them, that in a little while, they would not see him any more,
but then later, they would see him again. (16)

Questions.Q: What did the disciples ask each other?
Questions.A: They asked what Jesus meant, by saying, that in a little while they would not see him,
and then they would see him again later,
and also what he meant about going to the Father. (17-18)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus know?
Questions.A: He knew that the disciples wanted to ask him about what he had said. (19)

Questions.Q: What did he ask them?
Questions.A: He asked them if they were asking each other what he meant. (19)

Questions.Q: What will they do while the people of the world rejoices?
Questions.A: They will weep and mourn. (20)

Questions.Q: What does a woman feel when she is about to give birth?
Questions.A: She feels pain. (21)

Questions.Q: How does the woman feel when the baby is born?
Questions.A: The woman forgets her pain. (21)

Questions.Q: What was the reason that she forgot her pain?
Questions.A: She forgot her pain because she was happy that a baby has been born. (21)

Questions.Q: What will make them joyful again?
Questions.A: Jesus will see them again. (22)

Questions.Q: Who could take their joy away from them?
Questions.A: No one could take away their joy. (22)

Questions.Q: What would the disciples not do on that day?
Questions.A: They would not ask Jesus anything. (23)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus promise the disciples?
Questions.A: He promised that the Father will give them anything they ask of him in Jesus's name. (23)

Questions.Q: What had they not done yet?
Questions.A: They had not yet asked [the Father] for anything in Jesus's name. (24)

Questions.Q: What will be the result of their asking the Father for anything in Jesus's name?
Questions.A: They will receive [that for which they asked],
and their joy will be complete. (24)

Questions.Q: In what way was Jesus changing/going to change the way he told them about his Father?
Questions.A: He had been speaking figuratively to them, but in the future he will speak to them plainly about his Father. (25)
Questions.Alternative: In what way was Jesus changing the way he told them about his Father?
In what way was Jesus going to change the way he told them about his Father?

Questions.Q: What will the disciples do at that time?
Questions.A: They will ask [the Father], in Jesus's name, [for the things they need]. (26)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Jesus will not have to ask the Father on their behalf?
Questions.A: Jesus will not have to do it, because the Father loves them. (27)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that the Father loved the disciples?
Questions.A: The Father loved them because they loved Jesus,
and they had believed that Jesus had come from God. (27)

Questions.Q: From where had Jesus come?
Questions.A: He came from the Father and entered the world. (28)

Questions.Q: Where was he going now?
Questions.A: He was going back to the Father. (28)

Questions.Q: What did the disciples say about his speaking at that time?
Questions.A: They said he was speaking clearly and was not using figures of speech. (29)

Questions.Q: What did they know about Jesus?
Questions.A: They knew that he knew everything.
They knew that he did not need someone to ask him questions. (30)
Questions.Note: According to the T.H., Jesus knows what is in their minds and is able to answer their questions even before they ask him.
Questions.Alternative: What did they realize about Jesus?

Questions.Q: What was the result of that?
Questions.A: They believed that he had come from God. (30)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus ask the disciples?
Questions.A: He asked them if now they believed. (31)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus say was to happen soon?
Questions.A: They would all scatter to their own homes,
and no one would stay with him. (32)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Jesus was not alone?
Questions.A: He was not alone because his Father was with him. (32)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Jesus told them those things?
Questions.A: He told them those things because he wanted them to be at peace, being united with him. (33)

Questions.Q: What two things did Jesus tell them about the world?
Questions.A: They will have trouble in the world [the world of evil in its opposition to God],
but he/Jesus has overcome the world/destroyed the power of this world. (33)
Questions.Note: According to the T.H., "the world" in this verse is referring to the world of evil in its opposition to God, not to the people of the world.

Section.heading: John 17:1-5 Jesus prayed to the Father for himself. // Jesus prayed to God, and asked him to show people his [Jesus'] glory/greatness/how wonderful he is.

Questions.Q: What did Jesus pray to the Father?
Questions.A: He asked the Father to show how great/wonderful/powerful Jesus is. (1, 5)

Questions.Q: What would be the result of the Father honoring/showing the power of/glorifying his Son?
Questions.A: The Son would also honor/show the power of/glorify the Father. (1)
Questions.Alternative: What would be the result of the Father honoring his Son?
What would be the result of the Father showing the power of his Son?
What would be the result of the Father glorifying his Son?

Questions.Q: What is the reason that the Father gave the Son authority over all men?
Questions.A: The Father did that so that the Son could then give eternal life to all those whom the Father gave him. (2)

Questions.Q: What is the meaning of eternal life?
Questions.A: It is to know the only true God, and to know Jesus Christ, whom the Father sent. (3)

Questions.Q: What had Jesus done on earth?
Questions.A: He had honored the Father by finishing the work the Father had given him to do. (4)

Questions.Q: In what way did Jesus want the Father to honor him?
Questions.A: He wanted the Father to return him to the place in heaven where he had been and honor him in the same way he did when he was with the Father before he made the world. (5)

Section.heading: John 17:6-19 Jesus prayed to the Father for his disciples. // Jesus asked God to protect his disciples from the evil one/Satan.

Questions.Q: For whom did Jesus pray in these verses?
Questions.A: He prayed for the disciples/men whom the Father had given to him. (9)

Questions.Q: What had Jesus done with the men the Father had given to him?
Questions.A: He had made the Father known to them. (6)
He had told/taught them the words/message that the Father had given to him. (8, 14)

Questions.Q: To whom did they first belong?
Questions.A: They belonged first to the Father. (6)
Questions.Alternative: To whom did these men first belong?
To whom did the disciples first belong?
To who did they first belong?

Questions.Q: Who had obeyed God's word?
Questions.A: The men the Father had given to Jesus obeyed God's word. (6)

Questions.Q: What did those men/the disciples know?
Questions.A: They knew that everything the Father gave to the Son came from the Father. (7)
Questions.Alternative: What did those men know?
What did the disciples know?

Questions.Q: What did those men do concerning the message/words that Jesus told them?
Questions.A: They believed the message. (8)
Questions.Alternative: What did those men do concerning the message that Jesus told them?
What did those men do concerning the words that Jesus told them?

Questions.Q: What did those men/the disciples know and believe about Jesus?
Questions.A: They believed that he had come from the Father,
and that the Father had sent him. (8)
Questions.Alternative: What did those men know and believe about Jesus?
What did the disciples know and believe about Jesus?

Questions.Q: What did Jesus say about what he had and what the Father had?
Questions.A: He said that everyone that he had belonged to the Father
and all that the Father had belonged to him. (10)

Questions.Q: How was Jesus's glory shown?
Questions.A: His glory was shown through [those men]. (10)

Questions.Q: Where was Jesus planning to go?
Questions.A: He was going to the Father. (11)

Questions.Q: Where were those men/the disciples going?
Questions.A: They were staying in the world. (11)
Questions.Alternative: Where were those men going?
Where were the disciples going?

Questions.Q: In what way would the Father protect those men/the disciples?
Questions.A: He would protect them by his power/the power of his name. (11)
Questions.Alternative: In what way would the Father protect those men?
In what way would the Father protect the disciples?

Questions.Q: What would be the result of the Father protecting them?
Questions.A: They would be in agreement as Jesus and the Father were in agreement. (11)

Questions.Q: How had Jesus protected them?
Questions.A: He had protected them by the Father's power/the power of the name of the Father. (12)

Questions.Q: Which of the men/the disciples was lost?
Questions.A: The man, who would certainly go astray, was lost. (12)
Questions.Alternative: Which of the men was lost?
Which of the disciples was lost?

Questions.Q: What is the reason that he had to be lost?
Questions.A: That was necessary so that the scripture would be fulfilled. (12)
Questions.Alternative: What was fulfilled, when he was lost?
Why did he have to be lost?
Why did one of Jesus' followers have to be lost?
What is the reason that he had to perish?
Why did he have to perish?
Why did one of Jesus' followers have to perish?
Why was that necessary?

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Jesus prayed in that way for those men/the disciples?
Questions.A: He prayed in that way because he wanted them to be joyful as he was joyful/have joy as he had joy. (13)
Questions.Alternative: What is the reason that Jesus prayed in that way for those men?
What is the reason that Jesus prayed in that way for the disciples?

Questions.Q: What did the people of the world feel about those men/the disciples?
Questions.A: The people of the world hated them. (14)
Questions.Alternative: What did the people of the world feel about those men?
What did the people of the world feel about the disciples?

Questions.Q: What is the reason that the people of the world hated them?
Questions.A: The people of the world hated them because they did not think the same way as the people of the world think. (14)

Questions.Q: Who else did not belong to the people of the world?
Questions.A: Jesus did not. (14)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus not ask the Father to do?
Questions.A: He did not ask the Father to take those men/his disciples out of the world. (15)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus ask the Father to do?
Questions.A: He asked the Father to keep them safe from the evil one [Satan]. (15)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus and his disciples have in common?
Questions.A: They did not think the same way as the people of the world. (16)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus ask the Father to do to them?
Questions.A: Jesus asked the Father to receive them to himself for his service by means of his words, which are true. (17)

Questions.Q: What do you think it means to sanctify someone?
Questions.A: Key Term Check: It means to dedicate someone to serve God. (See "sanctify" in KBT in the "holy, holiness..." entry.)

Questions.Q: Whom had the Father sent into the world?
Questions.A: He sent Jesus. (18)

Questions.Q: Whom had Jesus sent into the world?
Questions.A: He sent those men/his disciples. (18)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Jesus dedicated himself to do what the Father wanted done?
Questions.A: He dedicated himself so that those men/his disciples may also dedicate themselves to do only what the Father wanted done. (19)

Section.heading: John 17:20-26 Jesus prayed to the Father for all believers. // Jesus prayed to God for everyone who will believe in him[Jesus]. // Jesus asked God to cause all, who believe in him [Jesus], to be united.

Questions.Q: For whom was Jesus praying?
Questions.A: He was praying for those people whom the Father had given to him,
and also for those who would believe in Jesus because of their message. (20)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus pray for them?
Questions.A: He prayed that they would all be in agreement/united,
and that they would be in/united with the Father and in/united with Jesus. (21)

Questions.Q: What was the relationship of the Father to Jesus?
Questions.A: The Father was in/united with Jesus, and Jesus was in/united with the Father. (21)

Questions.Q: What would be the result of their being in agreement/united?
Questions.A: The result would be that the world might believe that the Father had sent Jesus. (21)
Questions.Alternative: What would be the result of their being in agreement?
What would be the result of their being united?

Questions.Q: What did Jesus give to those people/the disciples?
Questions.A: He gave them the glory that the Father had given to him. // He caused them to become glorious, even as the Father caused him to be glorious. (22)
Questions.Note: See comments in the T.H. on the word "glory."

What did Jesus want for the disciples?

Section.heading: John 18:1-11 They/A group of Roman soldiers and some guards sent by the Jewish officials arrested Jesus.

Questions.Q: What happened to Jesus according to these verses?
Questions.A: He was arrested by the Roman soldiers and some temple guards. (5, 7)

Questions.Q: Where did Jesus go, after he had finished praying?
Questions.A: He left with his disciples and went across the Kidron valley into an olive grove. (1)

Questions.Q: How did Judas know where this grove was?
Questions.A: He knew where it was, because Jesus and his disciples had often met there. (2)

Questions.Q: Whom did Judas take with him to the grove?
Questions.A: He took a group of soldiers and some temple guards sent by the chief priests and Pharisees. (3)

Questions.Q: What were the soldiers and temple guards carrying?
Questions.A: They carried torches, lanterns and weapons. (3)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus know was going to happen?
Questions.A: He knew everything that was going to happen to him. (4)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus ask them?
Questions.A: He asked them whom they wanted. (4)

Questions.Q: What did they tell him?
Questions.A: They said that they wanted "Jesus of Nazareth." (5)

Questions.Q: What did he tell them?
Questions.A: He told them that he was Jesus of Nazareth. (5)

Questions.Q: Who was Judas?
Questions.A: He was the traitor. (5)
Questions.Note: Judas was also one of Jesus's disciples.

Questions.Q: Where was Judas?
Questions.A: He was standing with the soldiers. (5)

Questions.Q: What happened when Jesus said, "I am he"?
Questions.A: The soldiers and the temple guards moved back and fell to the ground. (6)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus ask them?
Questions.A: He asked them whom they wanted. (7)

Questions.Q: What did they tell him?
Questions.A: They said they wanted "Jesus of Nazareth." (7)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell them?
Questions.A: He told them that he had already said that he was Jesus of Nazareth. (8)
If they were looking for him, they should let the other men go. (8)

Questions.Q: What came true when he said that?
Questions.A: Jesus had just said in his prayer, "I have not lost one of those you gave me." (9)

Questions.Q: What did Simon Peter do?
Questions.A: He drew his sword, and cut off the right ear of the high priest's servant. (10)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell Peter to do after that?
Questions.A: He told him to put his sword away. (11)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus ask Peter?
Questions.A: He asked him if he should not drink the cup of/experience the suffering that his Father had given him. (11)

Section.heading: John 18:12-14 They/The Roman soldiers and some Jewish officials took Jesus to Annas, the high priest.

Questions.Q: What happened to Jesus according to these verses?
Questions.A: The soldiers and guards arrested him and tied him up. (12)
They took him to Annas. (13)

Questions.Q: What was Annas's relationship to Caiaphas?
Questions.A: Annas was the father-in-law of Caiaphas. (13)

Questions.Q: What office/position did Caiaphas occupy/have that year?

Questions.Alternative: What office did Caiaphas occupy that year?

What position did Caiaphas occupy that year?
What position did Caiaphas have that year?

Questions.A: He had told them that it was better that one man die for the people. (14)

Questions.Q: What did the girl at the door ask Peter?
Questions.A: She asked him if he was another of this man's disciples. (17)

Questions.A: He told her that he was not his disciple. (17)

Questions.Q: What did Simon Peter and another disciple do?
Questions.A: They followed Jesus. (15)

Questions.Q: Where did Peter stay?
Questions.A: He waited outside by the door. (16)

Questions.Q: What did the other disciple do?
Questions.A: He came back outside,
spoke to the girl on duty,

Questions.Q: What did the servants and officials/guards do?
Questions.A: They stood around a fire that they had made to keep warm from the cold. (18)

What did the servants and guards do?

Questions.A: He stood with the others around the fire. (18)

Questions.Q: About what did the high priest ask Jesus?
Questions.A: He asked him about his disciples and the things that he taught [to the people]. (19)

Questions.Alternative: What did Jesus say about his teaching to the people?
What did Jesus say about where he taught the people?
What did Jesus say about how he taught the people?

Questions.Q: What did one of the officials do?

Questions.Q: What is the reason that he did that?
Questions.A: He did that because of the way Jesus had talked to the high priest. (22)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus tell this official to do?
Questions.A: He told him to tell everyone what he had said wrong, if he had said something wrong. (23)

Section.heading: John 18:25-27 Peter said, two more times, that he was not a disciple of Jesus. // Peter said that he was not Jesus's disciple two more times.

Questions.Q: What did Peter deny according to these verses?
Questions.A: He denied that he was one of Jesus's disciples and that he had been with him in the olive grove. (25, 27)

Questions.Q: What was Peter doing at that time?
Questions.A: He was standing [by the fire] keeping himself warm. (25)

Questions.Q: What did [someone] ask him?
Questions.A: [Someone] asked him if he was one of the disciples of that man. (25)
Questions.Alternative: What did someone ask him?
What did ask him?

Questions.A: One of the high priest's servants, who was a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, challenged Peter. (26)

Questions.A: He asked, "Did I not see you with him in the olive grove?" (26)

Questions.Q: What happened after Peter had answered?
Questions.A: A rooster crowed. (27)

Section.heading: John 18:28-40 Pilate questioned Jesus about who he was. // The Jewish authorities took Jesus to Pilate to be tried/judged.

Questions.Q: What happened between Pilate and Jesus according to these verses?
Questions.A: Pilate asked Jesus who he was, and what he had done. (33, 35)

Questions.Alternative: Where did the Jewish authorities take Jesus next?
Where did they take Jesus next?

Questions.Q: What time of day was it?
Questions.A: It was early in the morning. (28)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that the Jews did not go inside the palace?
Questions.A: They did not go inside the palace because they wanted to keep themselves ceremonially clean, so that they would be able to eat the Passover meal. (28)

Questions.Q: Where did Pilate go?
Questions.A: He came outside to meet the Jews. (29)
Questions.Alternative: Where did Pilate meet them?
Where did Pilate meet the Jews?
Where did Pilate go to talk to the Jews?

Questions.Q: What did he ask them?
Questions.A: He asked them what charges they had against Jesus. (29)

Questions.Q: What was their answer?
Questions.A: They told Pilate that they would not have brought Jesus to him, if he were not a criminal. (30)

Questions.Q: What did Pilate want the Jews to do?
Questions.A: He wanted them to take Jesus and judge him according to their law. (31)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that they could not do that?
Questions.A: They could not do that because they did not have the right to put anyone to death. (31)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that they said they could not put anyone to death?

Questions.Q: What did Pilate ask the Jews?

The soldiers struck/slapped him in the face. (3)

Questions.Q: What do you think happened to someone when the soldiers crucified him/her?
Questions.A: Key Term Check: During that time/those years Roman soldiers crucified someone by either tying their arms to a crossbeam or pounding nails through their wrists. Then the person was pulled up on an upright post, which was planted in the ground, and the person was tied or nailed to the post at his ankles. (See "crucify" in KBT in the "cross" entry.)
Questions.Alternative: What do you think happened to someone when the soldiers crucified him?

Questions.Q: What is the reason that the Jews believed that Jesus had to die?
Questions.A: They said that their law stated that he must die, since he claimed to be the Son of God. (7)

Questions.Q: What is the reason that Pilate became even more afraid?
Questions.A: He became more afraid because he heard what the Jews had said about their law, and that Jesus claimed to be the Son of God. (8)

Questions.Q: Where did Pilate go?

Questions.Q: What did he ask Jesus?

How did Jesus respond?

Questions.A: He told him that the only power/authority he had over him was given to him from above [from God]. (11)

Questions.A: He sat on the judge's seat in the place called "The Stone Pavement." (13)

Questions.Q: What is the meaning of the Hebrew name "Gabbatha"?
Questions.A: It means "The Stone Pavement." (13)

Questions.Q: What day was this?
Questions.A: It was the day of Preparation for the/of Passover Week. (14)

Questions.Q: What time of day was it?
Questions.A: It was almost noon [about the sixth hour]. (14)

Questions.Q: What did Pilate say to the Jews?

Questions.Q: What did the Jews shout back at him?

What did they shout back at him?

How did they respond?

How did they respond to him?

Questions.A: He asked them if he should crucify their king. (15)

Questions.A: They told him that their only king was Caesar. (15)

Questions.A: He handed him over to [the Roman soldiers] to crucify him. (16)
Questions.Note: There is some confusion over who the "them" is to whom Pilate handed Jesus. Grammatically "them" ought to refer to the chief priests. However, the execution was carried out by the Romans. It was not a Jewish form of death; and in any case, the Jews would not have been permitted to carry it out.

Questions.Q: Who took charge of Jesus?
Questions.A: The soldiers took charge of him. (16)

Section.heading: John 19:17-27 The Roman soldiers crucified Jesus. // They/The soldiers took Jesus and nailed him to a cross.

Questions.Q: What happened to Jesus according to these verses?
Questions.A: The Roman soldiers crucified him. (18)

Questions.Q: What did Jesus carry [to his crucifixion/on the way to be crucified]?

Questions.Alternative: What did Jesus carry to his crucifixion?
What did Jesus carry on the way to be crucified?
What did Jesus carry?
